title: confiture build --list-files --format json
description: What `confiture build` would read, and why. One entry per selected file, in build order, naming the include_dirs entry that selected it, that entry's `order` and the include pattern that matched. Nothing is built.

env.description: The environment the selection was made for.

files.description: The selected files, in the order the build concatenates them.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root when it is under it.

entry.description: The include_dirs entry the file was found under.

pattern.description: The entry's include pattern that matched — the first, when more than one would.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. What the report found is in its own fields; a command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture` (`migrate up`, `lint`).

parser.description: What parsed the SQL behind this payload: the installed pglast release and the PostgreSQL grammar major it embeds. In the envelope since 1.16.0.
